title: Elon Musk Predicts Massive Leap in AI Capabilities That Will Make Today’s Tech Look Like ‘Caveman Playing With Sticks’ After OpenAI Reveals Intelligen
author: B
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

Elon Musk has predicted that future artificial intelligence systems could become so powerful that today's most advanced technology appears primitive by comparison, following OpenAI's disclosure of new intelligence metrics.
Musk Envisions Unprecedented AI Capabilities​Responding to OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki on X on November 22, Musk highlighted the potential of superintelligence backed by enormous computing infrastructure.

“Imagine what super intelligence will be like when we hit an exawatt. This will be like a caveman playing with sticks,” Musk wrote. elonmuskarchive.org

An exawatt represents one quintillion watts of power, a scale that dramatically exceeds the energy requirements of existing AI infrastructure.

Musk's prediction underscores his belief that expanding computing capacity could unlock extraordinary technological advances.
OpenAI Reveals Intelligence Metrics​In an essay titled Perplexity and Intelligence, Pachocki disclosed internal measurements tracking the progress of OpenAI's language models.

The research focused on perplexity, a metric that measures how effectively AI models predict information. Lower perplexity generally indicates improved predictive performance.

According to the findings, improvements in this metric have accompanied significant advances in conversational fluency, mathematical reasoning and other sophisticated capabilities. However, OpenAI's reported measurements are based on its internal evaluation framework. OpenAI
Growing Concerns Over AI Safety​Pachocki also advocated establishing shared safety thresholds across the AI industry, arguing that developers should better understand increasingly powerful systems before advancing beyond certain capability levels.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman endorsed the proposal, emphasizing the importance of transparency and industry-wide cooperation in maintaining safety and control.

The discussion highlights a growing tension between accelerating technological innovation and ensuring responsible AI development.

While Musk's vision of exawatt-powered superintelligence remains speculative, his remarks reflect the industry's increasingly ambitious expectations for artificial intelligence. As companies invest billions in advanced computing infrastructure, questions surrounding energy availability, technological limitations, regulatory oversight and the safe management of increasingly capable AI systems are likely to become more prominent.
